selection: Ten most recently active logical user-facing chats per project by inventory updated_at, including archived chats; internal subagents excluded from selection.
source_method: Read-only inspection of private local retained conversation logs and SQLite projections. Public records use aliases and an explicit field whitelist; no raw histories or private identifiers are exported.

count_method.indexed_turns: Read-only indexed projection, crosschecked against audit totals.
count_method.distinct_raw_task_starts: Distinct start identities across all retained rollover files for each logical chat; summed once per chat.
count_method.compactions: Recorded compaction events across all retained rollover files.
count_method.explicit_failed_turns: Indexed turns with explicit failure records; this is not a count of model-workflow failures.
count_method.historical_model_effort_pairs: Actual retained turn_context records, grouped by model and effort in first-observed order; context-record counts are not distinct completed turns or failure rates.

limits: This is a purposive, unequal-exposure sample; related chats are not independent failure observations and no model ranking is supported.
Indexed projections and raw starts differ because rollover, continuation and rewritten histories preserve different material.
Compaction counts and temporal proximity do not establish that compaction caused an incident or erased instructions.
Turn completion does not certify task completion; stale in-progress rows do not prove endless loops.
Historical models identify observed agent turns, not necessarily originating authors of inherited code; trained/evaluated models and explicitly selected helpers are separate.
A zero value for C09 indexed turns describes unavailable indexed history, not proof that no earlier work occurred.
